live_wake.note: An idle conversation is woken when an F1S upgrade or its seat's curator order lands; at most 24 wakes per conversation per day. Set enabled=false to stop waking (waiters exit within 5 s). Since 2026-11-01 an upgrade alone (directive/rules/live.md, no order for the seat) is recorded quietly and reaches the chat at its next prompt; set upgrade_wake=true to wake on upgrades again (7-day measure: 154 upgrade-only wakes, each re-reading a 200-440K context).
